subject: Archer portal: presign manifest orchestration and S3 staging
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@clearwave.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: security@clearwave.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Archer onboarding: presigned upload manifest & staging questions

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the Archer onboarding call last week. We've started prepping the S3 bucket for the staged evidence upload and have a couple of operational questions before we begin the bulk transfer: 

1) Would Redwood prefer we upload directly to your staging bucket via presigned URLs, or should we push to our interim bucket and you pull?
2) Can you confirm the expected CSV manifest format (field names, required hashes, and max filename length)?
3) We're planning to include compressed log bundles and PDF evidence (SOC2 extracts). Any size limits we should enforce?

Oliver (cc'd) will coordinate the S3 side. We also want to align on a small test window (50 files) before the full sync.

Can you share a sample manifest and any upload instructions?

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Security Operations
ClearWave Health

--
Elena Soto
ClearWave Health
Phone: +1 415-555-0199
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@clearwave.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Archer onboarding: presigned upload manifest & staging questions

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: presigned URLs are best for the staged evidence flow (reduces cross-account pull complexity), manifest is CSV with strict columns, and individual file size limit is 250MB for the initial ingest window (we can raise for logs with prior notice).

I've attached a sample manifest CSV and a short presign-instructions doc that includes an example script your SREs can run. Key manifest fields are:
- object_key (path relative to bucket)
- sha256_hex
- file_size_bytes
- evidence_type (pdf, json, tar.gz)
- upload_intent (initial|delta|test)

Proposed plan:
- Today/Tomorrow: your team uploads a 50-file test set using presigned URLs we issue.
- We validate checksums and ingest to an isolated staging prefix.
- If clean, we issue the production manifest window and increase parallelism.

I'll generate presigned URLs for the test set if you can share the test manifest back to me (archer-upload-manifest.csv). Attaching: archER-presign-example.csv (sample), presign-instructions.md, example_presign_script.sh.

I'll loop Kim and Marissa for coordination and audit tracking.

Jonas Weber
Head of Platform Security, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
--
Attachments: archER-presign-example.csv (text/csv), presign-instructions.md (text/markdown), example_presign_script.sh (text/x-shellscript)
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@clearwave.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Soto <elena.soto@clearwave.com>, security@clearwave.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 13:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Archer onboarding: presigned upload manifest & staging questions

Jonas — thanks, that helps a lot. A couple of clarifications from our ops side: 

- We'll produce the test manifest today and mark upload_intent=test.
- For compressed logs we'll split bundles to stay under 250MB.
- We have one ask: does Redwood have a standard filename normalization rule? We often include non-ascii characters in internal artifacts and want to avoid failures.

Also, Elena asked whether you can accept a SOC2 bridge letter in place of the full report during the initial ingest (we expect the full report this quarter).

Oliver
SRE, ClearWave

Oliver / Elena —

For filename normalization, please use UTF-8 NFC and replace whitespace with underscores. Avoid characters outside the printable ASCII range where possible; we'll normalize at ingest but it's better if your side normalizes first. Example: patient-records_20260215.tar.gz

Regarding the SOC2 bridge letter: yes, we can accept a signed bridge letter for initial access and ingestion verification. We'll require the full SOC2 report within 45 days of production cutover and an attestation email from your security lead. Please upload the bridge letter as evidence_type=pdf and upload_intent=test for the trial window.

Next steps:
- Oliver: send the 50-file test manifest to jonas.weber@redwood.com by EOD today.
- We'll generate presigned URLs and return them in ~2 business hours after receipt.
- Marissa will create JIRA-SEC-4821 to track completion and compliance evidence.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Security Integrations, Redwood Inference
